body: BLOCK, narrow enforceability defect. The requested independent-run rule is stated, but the named mutation assumes provenance the current published values do not retain. At base e584ad6, Candidates.without returns ordinary Candidates; GraphHsmm.infer accepts ordinary Candidates and returns HsmmResult; HsmmResult explicitly retains only candidateAnchors and states nomination provenance is residual. AblationResult is separate only when the caller chooses ablationUngated. Therefore a caller can apply without, call ordinary infer, obtain Unranked in an ordinary HsmmResult, and submit it with no field that distinguishes the ablation from provider abstention. The court currently says provenance identifies this case, but no such identity is required or derivable. Required one-doc successor: state that the current without-to-infer path is nonconforming and prevents execution; require a typed or checked construction/receipt boundary that records channel removal from the operation itself and cannot enter ordinary infer/control evidence; make the mutation bypass or falsify that boundary and fail. The prior estimand, independent control-run rule, separate AblationResult exclusion, report separation, and all earlier accepted material remain sound.
